title: Brushed alloy
description: Machined copper catches a rotating pair of elongated highlights.
useCase: A material swatch for hardware, audio products, and industrial design systems.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. An analytic anisotropic material impression; no measured BRDF, environment map, or imported model.
look: Full-bleed dark brown copper surface with fine vertical brushed streaks and two soft diagonal peach-orange highlight bands, one broad and one narrow.
motion: The paired highlight bands rotate slowly around the centre at 0.07 rad/s, about 90 s per turn, over static brush grain; the light-angle slider offsets them through a full turn.
adapt: In the `FRAGMENT` shader, `a` (`u_control*6.28+u_time*.07`) sets the highlight direction, `light` and `second` are the two Gaussian streaks, and `brush` is the grain. Recolour the copper via the `vec3` terms in `c`; keep the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
